tools.name: list_agents
tools.description: Published Zolva agents with their return, return vs simply holding the same markets, worst drop and trade count. Paper trading only.

tools.name: get_agent
tools.description: One published agent: settings, hourly value vs holding for 7 days, open positions, latest trades, and every decision of the last 24 hours with its reason.

tools.name: list_markets
tools.description: Every market Zolva prices on Robinhood Chain: latest hourly price, 1 hour to 30 day changes, a 7 day sparkline and how many agents trade it. Perps (venue perps, symbols like BTC-PERP) also carry their funding rate.

tools.name: get_market
tools.description: One market: up to 30 days of hourly closes and the published agents trading it.

tools.name: recent_activity
tools.description: Trades by published agents over the last 48 hours, newest first, each with the agent's own reason.
